# Alessandro Giuriati

> Personal website, digital CV and project portfolio of Alessandro Giuriati, a BSc Artificial Intelligence and Data Science student interested in software engineering, accessible technology, privacy and cybersecurity.

This website presents Alessandro Giuriati's academic background, technical skills, completed training, professional interests and selected software projects.

## Website

- [Personal website](https://alessandro-giuriati.github.io/): Academic background, skills, credentials, interests and selected projects.

## Projects

- [LocalKeyRemapper](https://github.com/Alessandro-Giuriati/LocalKeyRemapper): A privacy-first and accessibility-first native macOS application for creating and managing local keyboard-remapping profiles.
